title: Build claims from evidence
lead: The proposed approach is to connect design work, controlled tests and explicit limits.
description: This page describes a sensible development framework inferred from the supplied work; it is not a claim that every procedure is already formalized at Artifactory.

sections.title: Begin with a question
paragraphs: For sensing, specify the measurand and conditions. For design tooling, specify inputs, solver references and decisions a result should support.

sections.title: Keep stages distinct
paragraphs: A simulation can guide a design; a fabricated component can test a physical hypothesis; an intended-use study addresses another question again. Results should not be promoted across stages without evidence.

sections.title: Publish the limits
paragraphs: Dates, configurations, reference methods and failed cases make technical material useful to partners and investors. Review of the exact current process remains with the company.
